title: Plan frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a plan. The files it will touch live in the body as a markdown table, which INV-05 requires and the blast-radius tier reads — one declaration serving both. See Get-DeclaredFiles in tools/Get-SdlcFacts.ps1 for the shape.

predicted-tier.description: Blast radius as computed from the declared files. Gates the BUILD, not the launch — dispatch precedes any plan, so there is nothing to read at launch time. The verify stage compares this against the actual diff and halts if the actual tier is higher.
